gjort: The last two Norwegian videos are live: FO_2_H1 in adset DRYTREK_NO_FO and SP_6_H1 in DRYTREK_NO_SP.
The Norwegian campaign now runs 47 ads, all ACTIVE: PD 27, SP 8, CS 4, G 4, FO 2, CI 1, BOF 1. The queue is empty.
Nothing was re-rendered. Both dubs and their sources were still on disk from Saturday, so this cost 0 HeyGen credits.
The voice check that had blocked these two for three days was measuring the wrong thing, and it is now rewritten and retested.
varningar: The old check looked for where speech energy last crossed 15% of the peak and compared that margin with the source. That punishes the opposite of the fault it was meant to catch: a dub that says its last word clearly and then goes quiet gets a SHORT margin.
It now measures how loud the file still is in its final 100 ms against its own median, compared with the source. A cut-off ending is a sound that never fades out.
Validated on 14 dubs plus 14 copies cut mid-sound: whole dubs land between -141 and 0 dB, cut ones between +0.8 and +55 dB. Zero false alarms on the 14, and 12 of the 14 cuts caught.
Two films cannot be judged this way at all, because their own source ends at full volume (PD_13_H1 and SP_7_H1). Those are now reported as unmeasurable with a reason, never as green.
The test suite had encoded the bug: it asserted that a file ending in complete silence should fail. That test is rewritten.
